text:
Rae: Sync thread for CloudCo marketplace launch prep. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure listing artifacts, trial SKU wiring, EULA telemetry line, and a small co-marketing blurb. Quick owners?

Omar: I can own Azure metering config and offer submission. Heads up: Azure requires a separate metering plan JSON and a publisher tenant ID. Also need the 1-pager screenshot for the store tile (1400x600).

Li: I'll do images and region manifests for AWS/GCP. Plan is to produce per-cloud manifests and a single index file the portal can consume.

Camille: Legal/product: I'll finalize the EULA telemetry copy and the marketing blurb. Need exact event names so legal can confirm no PII leakage.

Rae: Decision: trial = 14d private SKU, one per account. Also we want a 3-line blurb for the marketplace: keep it focused on latency/cost benefits. Camille, can you draft?

Camille: Draft blurb: "CloudCo + Redwood Inference: low-latency inference, predictable throughput, and easy enterprise onboarding. Try a 14-day trial with strict data residency options." Feedback?

Omar: Looks good. For Azure metering I'll need: publisher_tenant_id, sku_code (e.g., CLOUDCO-TRIAL-14), and plan_id. Also confirm whether trial SKUs should be listed as free or paid with trial. Azure prefers free trial plans for private offers.

Li: Manifest example (index.json entry): ```json
{"cloud":"aws","region":"us-east-1","image":"ami-0f1a2b3c","kms":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999:key/aaa"}
{"cloud":"gcp","region":"us-central1","image":"projects/cloudco/global/images/cloudco-image-1","kms":"projects/cloudco/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/k"}
{"cloud":"azure","region":"eastus","image":"/subscriptions/111/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Compute/images/cloudcoImage","kms":"/subscriptions/111/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/v/keys/k"}
```

Camille: Telemetry snippet draft for listing: "We collect anonymous usage and error signals to improve service quality. Customers can provide CMKs to ensure image encryption keys remain customer-managed. No customer PII is exported without consent." Camille: list of events I'm asking for: app_launch, model_infer_latency_ms, sku_redeem, trial_expire, publish_error.

Rae: Product confirms events. Important: sku_redeem must NOT include user_email in the outbound telemetry feed; include sku_id and account_hash only. Internal billing will store account_id separately.

Omar: For Azure offer, we'll mark the trial as a private free plan. I'll prepare metering JSON and file a request to the marketplace team. Expect on my plate by EOD.

Li: CI notes: BUILD-AWS-9001, BUILD-GCP-9002, BUILD-AZ-9003. I'll push artifacts to s3/gs/az blob and write index.json to s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/4823456789-index.json.

marketplace-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo tenant created. Upload target: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hook/cloudco-4823. IdP metadata pending.

Camille: One more for co-marketing: can marketing get a hero screenshot + 2 short quotes? Product/SEs: supply a 30s ROI stat if available.

Rae: Assignments recap: Omar=Azure metering & offer, Li=images/manifests & CI, Camille=EULA + blurb + co-marketing copy, Rae=CloudCo PM comms and final review. Next check-in tomorrow 10am PT. If blockers, drop them here. :rocket:
